title: 2021 Sunseeker 86 Yacht Four Cabins MTU Power Turn-Key Miami Beach Vessel
description: 2021 86' yacht in Miami Beach - 21'3" beam, four cabins/ensuites, twin low‑hour MTU 12V2000 engines; five‑year survey.
html:
This 2021 86-foot Sunseeker based in Miami Beach presents a refined combination of contemporary styling, generous interior volume and turnkey readiness for extended cruising or waterfront entertaining. At 86 ft (26.21 m) with a 21’3″ beam and a 6.42 ft draft, the yacht offers a stable, spacious platform that comfortably accommodates up to eight guests across four cabins with four en‑suite heads; twin MTU 12V2000 M96L engines with low hours provide confident cruising performance and the vessel has been recently serviced and surveyed to ensure reliable operation.

86-Foot Luxury Motor Yacht: Notable Design Highlights

The yacht’s exterior lines are sleek and modern, with a broad 21’3″ beam that translates into generous interior volumes and excellent stability underway; the hull proportions and profile create an elegant silhouette while maximizing usable deck and salon space, and large glazing throughout promotes natural light and sightlines that enhance onboard comfort and ambiance.

Spacious Four-Cabin Layout and Guest Amenities

Below decks the arrangement is focused on guest comfort, offering four well-appointed cabins with four en‑suite heads to accommodate eight guests in privacy; staterooms feature thoughtful storage and circulation, and climate control systems have been recently serviced to maintain a comfortable interior environment for overnight stays and longer passages.

High-Performance MTU Powertrain and Recent Upgrades

Powered by twin MTU 12V2000 M96L engines showing low hours (447 and 453), the yacht cruises efficiently at about 23 knots, delivering a balance of speed and range for coastal runs or island hops; recent mechanical attention includes comprehensive servicing of propulsion systems and related machinery, underpinning dependable operation and reduced preparation time for new owners.

Versatile Decks and Expansive Entertaining Areas

Deck arrangements provide multiple zones for socializing and relaxation, with spacious aft areas suited to alfresco dining, lounging and seamless transitions to the water; foredeck and upper deck spaces further extend entertaining possibilities and offer comfortable sun‑use areas and easy access for tender or water toy deployment, all laid out to support convivial days on the water.

Recent Survey, Mechanical Works, and Service History

A five‑year survey has been completed and the vessel has received a suite of maintenance work including fresh bottom and running gear service, hull waxing, full mechanical servicing and A/C servicing, presenting a boat that has been carefully prepared and documented for near‑term cruising with attention to corrosion protection and system reliability.

Comprehensive Recap and Next Steps for Inquiry

This 2021 86‑foot Sunseeker combines spacious interiors, a four‑cabin/four‑head guest plan, a broad 21’3″ beam, conservative draft, twin MTU power with low hours and a recent five‑year survey plus extensive servicing—making it an attractive option for owners seeking a turn‑key motor yacht based in Miami Beach; for additional pictures, specification sheets or to arrange a private tour, please reach out to the broker or listing representative below.

For more information on this yacht including additional pictures and brochures, or to schedule a tour, please contact us below. While efforts have been made to ensure accuracy, readers are encouraged to verify details independently.
